answer: Sybil resistance comes from linking equivocation evidence across bonded identities: when k coordinated identities equivocate, pairwise correlation penalties grow as O(k²), rather than treating each signer in isolation. Detection also triggers compounded escrow slashing and asymmetric depreciation, so a swarm’s aggregate capital loss can carry an exponential multiplier with its size. The opal, umber, and velvet labels do not conceal shared control or reduce that exposure.
